levels.name: Fixture / Mock
levels.description: Local deterministic fixtures, mock providers, isolated test data, and no real platform network access.

levels.name: Pre-production Real Provider Read-only
levels.description: Independent pre-production, real provider authentication, allowlisted read-only calls, and no inventory mutation.

levels.name: Allowlisted Production Read-only Gray
levels.description: One approved tenant and shop with a bounded SKU set, observation window, and active kill switches.

levels.name: Controlled Production Write
levels.description: Owner-approved writes only after read-only gray acceptance, with per-operation confirmation, idempotency, audit, and rollback controls.

promotionRules: Each level requires all prior-level acceptance evidence.
Every promotion requires an explicit named approver.
A failed rollback, security, isolation, or performance gate blocks promotion.
L3 remains conditional until a separate Owner write approval is recorded.
